name: Dal ‘n Spinach
subtitle: A Simple Vegan Comfort Curry
description: A warm, creamy, and mildly spiced dish that combines the earthy richness of lentils with the fresh vibrance of spinach and the warmth of aromatic spices. Every bite delivers a comforting blend of nuttiness and creaminess without being too sweet or overly spicy. Packed with protein and fiber, this wholesome meal pairs perfectly with rice, roti, or even quinoa.
